items.title: Draft OSH&WC (Coal Mines) Regulations, 2026
items.note: Proposed successor to CMR 2017, made under the OSH&WC Code 2020 (s.136). The 45-day consultation window closed in March 2026 and no final notification has issued since, so the draft remains pending. CMR 2017 stays fully operative until it does.

items.title: Mining Plan & Mine Closure Guidelines, 2026
items.note: The Ministry of Coal has redrafted the mining plan and mine closure guidelines and held stakeholder consultation on 31 July 2026. No final instrument has been issued. MPG-2025 therefore remains in force; if the 2026 guidelines are notified they would supersede it, with plans uploaded before commencement staying under the 2025 regime.

items.title: The four Labour Codes — rollout
items.note: Wages, Industrial Relations, Social Security and OSH&WC Codes brought into force; the (Central) Rules, 2026 were finalised 8 May 2026. Jharkhand notified its own Code on Wages and OSH&WC rules back in 2021, ahead of the Codes commencing.

items.title: NCWA-XII wage settlement
items.note: The Eleventh National Coal Wage Agreement, signed 20 May 2023, covered 1 July 2021 to 30 June 2026. The Twelfth has not been signed, and JBCCI-XII — the joint bipartite committee that negotiates it — is reported as not yet constituted. Nothing has issued to report.

items.title: CMR 2017 — Assistant Manager scale
items.note: Amendment fixing the scale of appointment of Assistant Managers in coal mines.

items.title: Forest clearance — Van Rules 2023
items.note: The Van (Sanrakshan Evam Samvardhan) Rules, 2023 replaced the Forest (Conservation) Rules, 2022.
